cases.translation: David finds companions in the cave of Adullam.
cases.explain: The transitive verb находит governs the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Когда его ___ и весь его дом услышали об этом, они спустились к нему.
cases.translation: When his father and all his household heard about it, they came down to him.
cases.explain: Отец is the subject of the verb услышали, requiring nominative case.

cases.sentence: Все несчастные и должники собрались вокруг него и он стал их ___.
cases.translation: All those in distress and in debt gathered around him, and he became their leader.
cases.explain: The verb стал requires the instrumental case when showing what someone becomes.

cases.translation: With him were about four hundred men.
cases.explain: After numbers above 4, genitive plural is used in Russian.

cases.sentence: Пожалуйста, позволь моим ___ прийти и побыть у вас.
cases.translation: Please let my parents come and stay with you.
cases.explain: The verb позволь governs the accusative case for the object.

cases.sentence: Пророк Гад сказал Давиду, «Не оставайся в убежище, иди в ___».
cases.translation: The prophet Gad said to David, 'Don't stay in the stronghold, go into the land.'
cases.explain: The preposition в (into) with motion requires the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Саул сидел под Тамариском на холме, с копьем в ___.
cases.translation: Saul sat under the tamarisk tree on the hill with a spear in his hand.
cases.explain: The preposition в (in) with a fixed location requires the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Никто не открыл мне, что мой сын настроил против меня моего ___.
cases.translation: No one told me that my son stirred up my servant against me.
cases.explain: The transitive verb настроил governs the accusative case.

reading.ru: Давид покинул Гат и спасся в пещере Адулама.
reading.question: Where did David go after leaving Gath?
reading.explain: The text states: 'Давид покинул Гат и спасся в пещере Адулама' — David left Gath and took refuge in the cave of Adullam.

reading.ru: Все несчастные, обиженные и все должники собрались вокруг него, и он стал их вождем.
reading.question: What kind of people came to David in Adullam?
options: Those in distress, troubled, and those in debt
reading.correct: Those in distress, troubled, and those in debt
reading.explain: The text says: 'Все несчастные, обиженные и все должники собрались вокруг него' — Everyone in distress, troubled, and in debt gathered around him.

reading.ru: Пророк Гад сказал Давиду, «Не оставайся в убежище, иди в землю Иудеи».
reading.question: What did the prophet Gad tell David to do?
options: Leave the stronghold and go to Judah
Stay in the stronghold and wait
reading.correct: Leave the stronghold and go to Judah
reading.explain: Gad commanded: 'Не оставайся в убежище, иди в землю Иудеи' — Don't stay in the stronghold, go into the land of Judah.

reading.ru: Саул сидел под Тамариском на холме в Гиве, и его приближенные стояли вокруг него.
reading.question: Where was Saul when he learned about David?
options: Under the tamarisk tree on a hill in Gibeah
reading.correct: Under the tamarisk tree on a hill in Gibeah
reading.explain: The text describes: 'Саул сидел под Тамариском на холме в Гиве' — Saul sat under the tamarisk tree on the hill in Gibeah.

reading.ru: Ахимелех ответил царю, «Кто из всех твоих слуг так верен тебе, как Давид?»
reading.question: How did Ahimelech defend David to King Saul?
options: By saying David was the most faithful of all servants
reading.correct: By saying David was the most faithful of all servants
reading.explain: Ahimelech asked: 'Кто из всех твоих слуг так верен тебе, как Давид?' — Who of all your servants is as faithful to you as David?

reading.ru: Но царь сказал, «Ты непременно умрешь, Ахимелех, ты и вся семья твоего отца».
reading.question: What judgment did Saul pronounce on Ahimelech?
options: Death for him and his whole family
reading.correct: Death for him and his whole family
reading.explain: Saul said: 'Ты непременно умрешь, Ахимелех, ты и вся семья твоего отца' — You will surely die, Ahimelech, you and all your father's household.
